findings_14.title_zh: 血肌酐增高、肾小球滤过率降低、胱抑素C增高
findings_14.title_en: Elevated Creatinine, Reduced eGFR, and Elevated Cystatin C
findings_14.explanation_zh: 肌酐是临床肾功能检验的重要指标之一，由肌肉代谢产生并经肾脏排泄。血肌酐升高见于各种原因引起的肾小球滤过功能减退，但仅一次轻度升高不一定有不可逆病理意义。肾小球滤过率（eGFR 73.23 mL/min）是早期评估肾功能减退的有效指标。胱抑素C能更早期敏感地反映肾小球滤过功能受损，但慢性炎症、甲状腺异常等也可轻度影响。
findings_14.explanation_en: Serum creatinine is an established biomarker of renal excretory function. eGFR (73.23 mL/min/1.73m²) falls in the CKD Stage 2 range (60-89 mL/min). Cystatin C (1.18 mg/L) is a sensitive endogenous marker of glomerular filtration less dependent on muscle mass. Note that in US standard references, Cr 1.16 mg/dL is within the broad normal laboratory range (0.7-1.3 mg/dL), but represents a mild age- and hypertension-related reduction in GFR requiring longitudinal monitoring.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 健康管理门诊 / 肾内科门诊就诊复查。避免使用肾毒性药物（如部分解热镇痛药NSAIDs、不明成分草药）。定期复查肾功能三项、尿常规及尿微量白蛋白。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Consult Health Management / Nephrology Clinic for periodic surveillance. Avoid nephrotoxic agents (NSAIDs, aminoglycosides). Recheck basic metabolic panel, cystatin C, and urine microalbumin every 6-12 months.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 肌酐是临床肾功能检验的重要指标之一。肌酐是肌酸的代谢产物，由肾脏排泄。血肌酐升高见于各种原因引起的肾小球滤过功能减退，但仅一次轻度升高不一定有意义。肾小球滤过率是早期了解肾脏功能减退的有效指标，指导肾脏疾病的诊断和治疗。胱抑素C可以更敏感地反映肾功能的异常，但炎症、肿瘤及免疫疾病也可导致它增高。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 健康管理门诊/肾内科门诊就诊复查。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Creatinine is a key clinical marker for renal function, produced as a byproduct of creatine phosphate metabolism and cleared through the kidneys. Serum creatinine elevation indicates diminished glomerular filtration, though a solitary mild elevation may not indicate chronic disease. Estimated GFR provides early detection of decreased renal function. Cystatin C reflects renal impairment with higher sensitivity, although systemic inflammation, malignancy, and immune conditions can also contribute to elevation.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Follow-up consultation at Health Management Clinic or Nephrology Outpatient Clinic for re-examination.

findings_14.title_zh: 高血压病、高脂血症（治疗中）、双侧颈动脉内中膜增厚、血管弹性下降、视网膜动脉细伴中轴反光增强
findings_14.title_en: Hypertension, Hyperlipidemia (Treated), Carotid IMT, Decreased Arterial Elasticity, Retinal Arteriosclerosis

key_metrics.value: 双侧内中膜增厚 (IMT 0.11 cm = 1.1 mm)
视网膜动脉细，中轴反光增强 (I级视网膜动脉硬化改变)

findings_14.explanation_zh: 高血压与血脂异常是动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病（ASCVD）的核心危险因素。检查显示颈动脉内中膜增厚（1.1mm）、右侧baPWV（1477 cm/s）轻度增快提示大中动脉弹性轻度减退，眼底镜下视网膜小动脉反光增强提示外周微血管也有轻度硬化改变。目前正规律服药（降压药与阿托伐他汀），LDL-C已控制在73.5 mg/dL（1.90 mmol/L）的理想水平，但甘油三酯仍轻度偏高。
findings_14.explanation_en: Chronic hypertension and dyslipidemia contribute to systemic arterial remodeling. Subclinical macrovascular findings include bilateral carotid intima-media thickening (IMT 1.1 mm) and elevated right brachial-ankle pulse wave velocity (baPWV 1477 cm/s). Funduscopy shows grade 1 arteriolar narrowing with central light reflex. On active atorvastatin therapy, LDL-C is well-controlled at 73.5 mg/dL, while triglycerides remain mildly elevated at 178.9 mg/dL.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 低盐低脂饮食，戒烟限酒，规律服用降压药及他汀类降脂药。保持心情舒畅，定期自测血压并记录。建议6-12个月复查血脂四项，半年复查颈动脉超声，每年复查眼底。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Maintain low-sodium, heart-healthy diet, regular aerobic exercise. Continue current antihypertensive and statin regimens. Home blood pressure monitoring. Follow up carotid duplex ultrasound in 6-12 months and annual dilated eye exam.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 高血压与遗传因素、长期精神紧张、肥胖、水盐代谢等因素有关。大多数起病缓慢，缺乏特殊的临床表现，常见症状有头晕、头痛、颈项板紧、疲劳、心悸等。高血压病常见并发症有高血压性心脏病、脑血管病、慢性肾功能衰竭、心力衰竭等。血脂异常通常指血清中胆固醇和（或）甘油三酯水平升高，俗称高脂血症。实际上血脂异常也泛指包括低高密度脂蛋白胆固醇血症在内的各种血脂异常。血脂异常的主要危害是增加动脉粥样硬化性心血管疾病的发病危险。颈动脉内中膜增厚往往是动脉粥样硬化的早期表现，动脉粥样硬化多见于40岁以上的男性和绝经期后的女性。本病的危险因素包括：高龄、高血压、血脂异常、糖尿病、吸烟、嗜酒、肥胖、遗传因素、体力活动减少、性情急躁等。颈动脉粥样硬化往往提示全身血管动脉粥样硬化，包括冠状动脉及脑动脉。血管弹性下降多由脂质代谢异常引起动脉粥样硬化，以及长期血管压力过大导致动脉内膜病变所致。另外，随着年龄老化，血管弹性亦逐渐下降。视网膜动脉硬化/视网膜动脉细/中轴反光增强：多见于高血压眼底改变，亦存在于老年人。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 低盐低脂饮食，忌烟限酒，适当多食蔬菜水果，适当体育锻炼，控制体重，监测血压、血糖及血脂等，避免情绪激动，按时服用降压药，定期自测血压并做好记录，健康管理门诊/全科门诊随诊，继续当前治疗方案，6-12个月复查血脂，半年复查颈动脉B超，每年复查眼底。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Hypertension is associated with genetic predisposition, chronic stress, obesity, and electrolyte/water regulation. Most cases develop insidiously without prominent early symptoms; classic symptoms include dizziness, headache, neck tightness, fatigue, and palpitations. Common complications include hypertensive heart disease, cerebrovascular accidents, chronic kidney failure, and heart failure. Dyslipidemia denotes elevated cholesterol and/or triglycerides, increasing ASCVD risk. Carotid IMT thickening represents early atherosclerosis, widely seen in men >40 and postmenopausal women. Decreased vascular elasticity results from lipid metabolic disorders, atheroma, and chronic intravascular barotrauma. Retinal arteriolar narrowing with augmented central reflex reflects hypertensive microvascular change.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Low-salt low-fat diet, smoking cessation, alcohol restriction, increased vegetables/fruits, exercise, weight control, regular blood pressure/lipid/glucose monitoring, compliance with antihypertensive regimen, follow-up in 6-12 months for lipids, 6 months for carotid ultrasound, and annually for funduscopic exam.

findings_14.explanation_zh: 日常饮食下，空腹血尿酸>420 μmol/L（7.0 mg/dL）即可诊断高尿酸血症。本次测定值为488 μmol/L（8.20 mg/dL）。高尿酸是嘌呤代谢紊乱所致，常与肥胖、代谢综合征、肾小球滤过率下降聚集发生。长期高尿酸可沉积在关节引起急性痛风，也可在肾脏沉积诱发肾间质病变与尿酸性肾结石（本次B超亦查出左肾0.5cm结石）。
findings_14.explanation_en: Fasting serum uric acid is elevated at 488 μmol/L (8.20 mg/dL; US normal cutoff <7.0-7.2 mg/dL). Hyperuricemia reflects impaired purine turnover or decreased renal clearance (correlating with eGFR 73). Chronic hyperuricemia predisposes to gouty arthritis and nephrolithiasis (coinciding with the 0.5 cm left renal calculus detected on ultrasound).
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 忌烟限酒，少吃动物内脏、海鲜、肉汤、香肠等高嘌呤食物；杜绝高果糖含糖饮料；每日饮水2000-2500ml以上促进尿酸排出；控制体重。内分泌/风湿科随访，必要时启动降尿酸药物治疗（如别嘌醇、非布司他）。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Strict dietary purine restriction (avoid organ meats, rich broths, shellfish, beer, high-fructose corn syrup). Ensure abundant hydration (>2.0-2.5 L/day). Endocrinology or rheumatology consultation to evaluate indications for uric-acid-lowering therapy.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 1) 日常饮食下，非同日两次空腹血尿酸水平>420umol/l即可诊断高尿酸血症 (HUA)。2) HUA是嘌呤代谢障碍引起的代谢性疾病。常与肥胖、糖脂代谢紊乱、高血压、动脉硬化和冠心病等聚集发生。少数患者可以发展为痛风，出现急性关节炎、痛风肾和痛风石等临床表现。3) 血液系统肿瘤、慢性肾功能不全、先天性代谢异常、中毒、药物等因素可引起血尿酸水平升高。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 忌烟限酒，少吃动物内脏、动物浓汤、海鲜及大肠、香肠等高嘌呤饮食，减少含糖饮料的摄入，增加新鲜蔬菜及含果糖较少的水果的摄入，多饮水（心肾功能正常者，每日2000ml以上），控制体重。风湿免疫科/内分泌科门诊就诊，降尿酸治疗。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: 1) Hyperuricemia (HUA) is diagnosed when non-consecutive fasting serum uric acid exceeds 420 μmol/L under normal dietary conditions. 2) HUA is a metabolic disorder of purine metabolism, often clustering with obesity, dyslipidemia, hypertension, and CAD. A subset of patients progresses to clinical gout, acute arthritis, gouty nephropathy, and tophi. 3) Renal insufficiency, hematologic disease, medications, and metabolic variants may elevate uric acid.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Abstain from tobacco/alcohol, restrict high-purine foods (organ meats, broth, seafood, sausages), reduce sugary beverages, increase hydration (>2000 mL/day if normal cardiorenal function), control weight. Consult Rheumatology or Endocrinology for urate-lowering therapy.

findings_14.title_zh: 左肺下叶少许小钙化灶 (Small Calcifications in Left Lower Lung Lobe)
findings_14.title_en: Small Calcified Nodules in Left Lower Lobe

key_metrics.value: 左肺下叶少许小钙化结节，直径约3-4mm

findings_14.explanation_zh: 肺部钙化灶多属于良性陈旧性病变，通常是既往肺部感染、炎症或结核修复愈合后留下的钙化样疤痕。CT表现为边缘锐利的高密度影，无渗出或实质占位征象，恶性风险极低，一般无需药物治疗。
findings_14.explanation_en: Screening chest CT demonstrates 3-4 mm well-circumscribed dense calcifications in the left lower lobe. These represent classic healed granulomatous sequelae from prior pulmonary inflammation or exposure, exhibiting completely benign characteristics.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 戒烟，避免二手烟及粉尘暴露。无需特殊处理，每年健康体检低剂量胸部CT复查随访对比即可。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Routine annual low-dose chest CT follow-up for stability; no intervention required.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 肺部钙化灶多属于陈旧性病灶，通常是结核、炎症或其他肺部损伤修复留下的钙化样瘢痕，影像表现为边缘清楚的高密度影，一般不需治疗。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 随诊，定期复查胸部CT，呼吸内科门诊就诊。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Pulmonary calcifications typically represent inactive chronic sequelae—calcified scarring following past infection, inflammation, or tuberculosis. Radiologically demonstrated as well-circumscribed high-density lesions, requiring no specific therapeutic intervention.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Routine outpatient follow-up, periodic low-dose chest CT re-examination, consult Pulmonology clinic if symptoms develop.

key_metrics.value: 肝实质光点细密，回声增高，后方回声衰减，血管显示欠清
ALT 28 U/L, AST 23 U/L, r-GT 33 U/L (肝酶完全正常)

findings_14.explanation_zh: B超显示典型轻中度脂肪肝声像。本次肝酶指标完全正常（ALT 28, AST 23, GGT 33, 胆红素均正常），提示处于单纯性脂肪浸润阶段，未发生显著脂肪性肝炎或肝细胞坏死。主要诱因为超重/肥胖（BMI 29.9）与代谢综合征相关胰岛素抵抗。
findings_14.explanation_en: Abdominal ultrasound demonstrates characteristic diffuse increase in hepatic parenchymal echogenicity with deep acoustic attenuation, consistent with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). Importantly, liver transaminases (ALT 28, AST 23, GGT 33) and bilirubin are completely normal, denoting simple steatosis without active steatohepatitis.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 低脂低糖膳食，严格控制精制碳水和高热量食物，戒酒，坚持中等强度有氧运动，以减轻体重5%-10%为目标。6-12个月复查肝脏B超及肝生化功能。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Lifestyle modification targeting 5-10% weight loss via caloric restriction and regular physical exercise. Avoid hepatotoxins/excessive alcohol. Follow up liver ultrasound and transaminases annually.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 脂肪肝为常见肝病之一，包括酒精性和非酒精性脂肪肝。好发于肥胖、过量饮酒、高脂饮食、糖尿病等人群。少数病情可进展为肝硬化等。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 低脂低糖饮食，忌酒，适当运动，减轻体重，健康管理门诊随诊，6个月复查。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Fatty liver disease is among the most prevalent hepatic disorders, encompassing alcoholic and non-alcoholic forms. Predisposing factors include obesity, alcohol excess, high-fat diet, and diabetes. A minority may progress to chronic steatohepatitis and cirrhosis.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Low-fat low-sugar diet, alcohol cessation, regular exercise, weight loss; follow up in Health Management Clinic with re-examination in 6 months.

findings_14.title_zh: 肥胖 (Obesity - BMI 29.9, 中心性肥胖)

key_metrics.value: 29.9 kg/m²

findings_14.explanation_zh: 按照中国成人BMI标准，BMI≥28为肥胖（29.9已接近30）；男性腰围≥90cm（98cm）属于中心性腹型肥胖。内脏脂肪蓄积是高血压、高甘油三酯、胰岛素抵抗和动脉粥样硬化的共同病理基础。
findings_14.explanation_en: A BMI of 29.9 kg/m² classifies as Class I Obesity under Asian criteria (cutoff ≥28 kg/m²) and upper Overweight / borderline Obese under WHO criteria. Waist circumference of 98 cm confirms central/visceral adiposity, the driving etiology of metabolic syndrome.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 制定科学均衡的减重计划：控制总热量摄入，采用地中海或DASH饮食模式；每周进行至少150分钟快走、游泳或椭圆机等中等强度运动，配合抗阻肌力训练。营养科或健康管理门诊随诊指导。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Comprehensive lifestyle intervention emphasizing DASH/Mediterranean diet, caloric deficit, and 150+ min/week moderate aerobic activity paired with resistance training. Nutritionist consultation.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 肥胖是遗传、环境等多种因素相互作用的结果，也是心脑血管疾病、呼吸系统疾病、糖尿病和肿瘤等多种疾病的重要危险因素。减重可以预防和治疗肥胖相关性并发症改善健康状况。BMI的计算公式是体重(kg)除以身高(m)的平方。中国成人BMI正常范围18.5-23.9，≥24为超重，≥28为肥胖。成人腰围≥90厘米（男性）或≥85厘米（女性）为中心性肥胖。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 健康的减肥方式是在均衡饮食、减少热能摄入的基础上增加合适的运动量。健康管理门诊/营养科门诊就诊。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Obesity arises from interplay between genetic and lifestyle/environmental factors and constitutes a major independent risk factor for ASCVD, respiratory disease, type 2 diabetes, and malignancies. Weight loss ameliorates obesity-related comorbidities. Under Chinese adult criteria, BMI ≥ 24 is overweight, ≥ 28 is obese. Waist circumference ≥ 90 cm in males indicates central adiposity.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Healthy weight reduction through calorie restriction, balanced nutrition, and progressive physical exercise. Consult Health Management or Clinical Nutrition Clinic.

key_metrics.value: 腰围 98 cm (标准 ≥90 cm) ✅ 满足
139/87 mmHg 及服药中 ✅ 满足

key_metrics.name_zh: 血糖异常/糖化血红蛋白
key_metrics.value: HbA1c 5.8%, 胰岛素 172.5 pmol/L (偏高上限) ✅ 满足

findings_14.explanation_zh: 代谢综合征是一组以腹型肥胖、糖脂代谢紊乱及高血压为特征的综合征。满足5项中3项即可确诊。患者同时具备腹型肥胖（腰围98cm）、高血压治疗中（139/87）、高甘油三酯（2.02 mmol/L）及糖尿病前期倾向，已完全符合代谢综合征诊断，是心脑血管病的关键危险因素。
findings_14.explanation_en: The patient meets 4 out of 5 diagnostic criteria for Metabolic Syndrome: central obesity (waist 98 cm), treated hypertension, hypertriglyceridemia (2.02 mmol/L / 178.9 mg/dL), and pre-diabetic dysglycemia with borderline hyperinsulinemia (172.5 pmol/L).
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 综合多靶点干预：控盐（每日<5g）、控油、减糖，严格戒烟限酒，定期监测血压、血糖、血脂四项。全科/内分泌门诊综合随诊管理。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Multimodal metabolic risk reduction targeting blood pressure, lipids, visceral weight loss, and insulin sensitization.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 代谢综合征是一种以腹型肥胖、高血糖、高血压以及血脂异常为特征的代谢紊乱性疾病。只要满足以下5项中任何3项及以上就能诊断：1. 腰围≥90cm（亚洲男性），腰围≥80cm（亚洲女性）；2. 血压≥130/85mmHg和（或）已确诊为高血压并治疗者；3. 空腹血糖>5.6mmol/L，或已诊断为2型糖尿病并治疗；4. 甘油三酯≥1.7mmol/L或已接受治疗；5. 高密度脂蛋白胆固醇：<1.03mmol/L（男），<1.29mmol/L（女），或已接受治疗。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 低脂低盐低糖饮食，忌烟限酒，适当体育锻炼，监测血压、血糖、血脂，健康管理门诊就诊。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Metabolic syndrome is a constellation of metabolic abnormalities characterized by abdominal obesity, hyperglycemia, hypertension, and dyslipidemia. Diagnosis requires ≥ 3 of 5 criteria: 1) Waist ≥ 90 cm (Asian male); 2) BP ≥ 130/85 mmHg or treated hypertension; 3) Fasting glucose > 5.6 mmol/L or treated diabetes; 4) Triglycerides ≥ 1.7 mmol/L; 5) HDL-C < 1.03 mmol/L in males.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Low-fat, low-salt, low-sugar diet, smoking cessation, alcohol restriction, regular aerobic exercise, monitoring of blood pressure, glucose, and lipid panel. Health management clinic consultation.

key_metrics.value: 左肾集合系统见一个强光团，大小约0.5cm，后方伴声影
潜血阴性，红细胞 2/μL (正常范围)

findings_14.explanation_zh: 超声发现左肾集合系统单发0.5cm结石，目前未见集合系统积水分离，双侧输尿管未扩张，尿常规红细胞正常且无潜血。结合血尿酸偏高（488 μmol/L），该结石可能为尿酸盐或草酸钙结石。0.5cm结石多数可通过多饮水和药物辅助自行排出或长期稳定观察。
findings_14.explanation_en: Ultrasound reveals a solitary 0.5 cm hyperechoic stone with acoustic shadowing in the left renal collecting system. No hydronephrosis or calyceal dilation; urinalysis shows no hematuria. High serum uric acid (8.2 mg/dL) points to a uric acid or calcium oxalate composition.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 每日保持充足饮水量（2000-2500ml以上），适当跳跃运动；限制高嘌呤及高草酸饮食。若突发剧烈腰痛、血尿或发热，应立即泌尿外科就诊。建议3-6个月复查泌尿系B超。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Hydration therapy (>2.5 L water/day), alkalization if uric acid stones suspected, periodic renal ultrasound in 3-6 months. Seek emergency care if renal colic, hematuria, or fever occurs.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 肾结石是尿石症的一种，多数位于肾盂肾盏内，肾实质结石少见，可引起肾绞痛、血尿。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 适当多饮水、适当运动，3个月复查B超，健康管理门诊/泌尿外科门诊随诊。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Nephrolithiasis is a common form of urolithiasis, mostly situated within the renal pyelocaliceal system. It may cause renal colic, hematuria, or secondary urinary tract obstruction.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Maintain generous fluid intake, engage in regular physical activity, repeat ultrasound in 3 months; Urology or Health Management follow-up.

findings_14.title_zh: 甲状腺双侧叶实质回声不均伴多发结节 (TI-RADS 3类)
findings_14.title_en: Bilateral Thyroid Heterogeneous Echotexture with Multiple Nodules (TI-RADS 3)

key_metrics.value: 实质回声不均匀，多个椭圆形低回声结节，右侧较大者约0.3cm，左侧较大者约0.5*0.2cm，边界清晰，CDFI未见异常血流
TI-RADS 3类 (良性可能性大，恶性风险 <2-5%)
TSH 2.90 mIU/L, FT3 4.53, FT4 12.02, TPOAb 1.28, ATGAb 0.81 (甲功五项及抗体均完全正常)

findings_14.explanation_zh: 甲状腺回声不均匀常提示轻度慢性甲状腺炎样改变，但甲功五项（TSH、FT3、FT4）及自身抗体（TPOAb、ATGAb）均在理想正常范围内。双侧结节微小（最大0.5cm），形态规则，边界清晰，无微钙化或异常血流，归入TI-RADS 3类，基本属于良性病变，无需穿刺或手术。
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 无需特殊药物治疗，保持作息规律，避免盲目过量或极度缺碘。建议每6-12个月复查甲状腺B超和甲状腺功能。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Benign ultrasound morphology and euthyroid function. No biopsy or surgical indication. Annual ultrasound surveillance.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 甲状腺实质回声不均匀是超声所见的一类表现，常见于自身免疫性甲状腺炎，如桥本甲状腺炎等，可伴或不伴甲状腺功能异常。甲状腺内的肿块统称甲状腺结节，是常见的甲状腺疾病。分良性及恶性，良性结节占大多数。一般无症状，多为体检发现。目前以TI-RADS分类来评估良恶性的可能性，1-3类基本是良性病变，可以观察；4-5类有恶性可能，需要穿刺活检或手术来明确性质。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 健康管理门诊随诊，每半年复查甲状腺B超及T3T4全套。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Heterogeneous thyroid echotexture is an ultrasound pattern frequently observed in autoimmune thyroiditis (such as Hashimoto's), with or without hormonal dysfunction. Thyroid nodules are overwhelmingly benign. The TI-RADS classification stratifies malignancy risk: categories 1-3 indicate benignity suitable for observation, while categories 4-5 require fine-needle aspiration biopsy (FNAB) or surgical assessment.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Follow up in Health Management Clinic with repeat thyroid ultrasound and full T3/T4 thyroid hormone panel every 6 months.
findings_14.explanation_en: Thyroid ultrasound revealed mildly heterogeneous parenchymal echotexture with discrete small bilateral nodules (largest 0.5 x 0.2 cm on left, 0.3 cm on right). No suspicious sonographic features (no hypoechogenicity, taller-than-wide shape, irregular margins, or microcalcifications). Classified as TI-RADS 3 (probably benign, malignancy risk <2-5%). Complete thyroid hormonal profile (TSH 2.90, FT3 4.53, FT4 12.02) and antibodies (TPOAb, TgAb) are completely normal, confirming euthyroid state.

findings_14.explanation_zh: 虽然本次空腹血糖正常（4.86 mmol/L / 87.6 mg/dL），但根据国际与中国糖尿病指南，HbA1c在5.7%~6.4%区间属于糖尿病前期。同时空腹胰岛素（172.5 pmol/L）位于正常参考值上限，反映存在高胰岛素代偿及外周胰岛素抵抗。
findings_14.explanation_en: Fasting blood glucose is optimal at 87.6 mg/dL (4.86 mmol/L). However, HbA1c is 5.8% (American Diabetes Association defines prediabetes as HbA1c 5.7%-6.4%). Fasting insulin is at the uppermost ceiling of normal (172.5 pmol/L = 24.0 μIU/mL), indicating insulin resistance.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 全科或内分泌门诊随访，可进一步行口服葡萄糖耐量试验（OGTT）评估胰岛功能。严格调整饮食碳水比例，增加运动，控制体重，每3-6个月复查HbA1c。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Lifestyle modification to prevent progression to overt type 2 diabetes. Consider 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT). Recheck HbA1c in 3-6 months.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 6.1mmol/L≤空腹血糖<7.0mmol/L，或7.8mmol/L≤餐后2小时血糖<11.1mmol/L，或5.7%≤糖化血红蛋白A1c<6.5%，为“糖尿病前期”。“糖尿病前期”通过生活方式干预能够明显减少、延缓糖尿病的发生。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: (1) 健康管理门诊/全科门诊就诊，进一步行葡萄糖耐量试验 (OGTT) 检查。(2) 戒烟限酒，调整饮食总能量、饮食结构，适量运动，控制体重，坚持自我监测血糖，每3个月复查糖化血红蛋白。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Pre-diabetes is defined by fasting plasma glucose 6.1-6.9 mmol/L (impaired fasting glucose), 2-hour postprandial glucose 7.8-11.0 mmol/L (impaired glucose tolerance), or HbA1c 5.7%-6.4%. Lifestyle modification during this window significantly delays or prevents transition to overt type 2 diabetes.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: (1) Consult Health Management or General Practice Clinic for oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT). (2) Tobacco cessation, alcohol moderation, balanced caloric intake, physical exercise, weight control, self-glucose monitoring, and 3-month HbA1c surveillance.

findings_14.title_zh: 颈椎退行性改变 (Cervical Spondylosis / Degeneration)

key_metrics.value: 颈椎生理曲度变直，椎体前、后缘骨质增生，椎间隙未见明显狭窄

findings_14.explanation_zh: CR片显示颈椎生理曲度变直伴唇样骨赘形成（骨质增生），为长期伏案、低头工作造成的早期颈椎退行性退变。椎间隙尚保持良好，未见明显椎体脱位或骨质破坏。
findings_14.explanation_en: Cervical lateral radiography demonstrates straightening of physiologic lordosis with anterior/posterior marginal osteophyte formation, typical of occupational postural strain and early cervical spondylosis without severe intervertebral disc collapse.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 避免长时间低头伏案或看手机；调整电脑屏幕至视线平齐；工间进行颈部肌肉拉伸放松；选择高度合适的支撑性枕头。如有上肢麻木、放射痛或眩晕，需骨科专科诊疗。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Ergonomic adjustments, neck posture correction, active stretching. Avoid prolonged cervical flexion.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 颈椎退行性改变由于椎间隙狭窄，关节囊、韧带松弛，造成颈段脊柱不稳定的恶性循环，最后出现脊髓、血管或神经刺激或压迫的表现。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 注意颈部姿势，适当颈部活动，枕头不宜过高，避免长期伏案工作和低头看手机，必要时骨科专科诊治。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Cervical spine degeneration stems from intervertebral disc dehydration/narrowing, joint capsule laxity, and hyperostosis, precipitating biomechanical cervical instability that may irritate or compress adjacent nerve roots, vertebral arteries, or spinal cord.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Maintain ergonomic cervical posture, gentle neck mobility exercises, appropriate pillow height, avoid prolonged downward head postures (screens/desk work); consult Orthopedics if radicular symptoms appear.

findings_14.title_zh: 双眼豹纹状近视眼底、晶体密度增高
findings_14.title_en: Bilateral Tigroid Myopic Fundus & Increased Lens Density

key_metrics.value: 双眼豹纹状近视眼底，视网膜动脉细，中轴反光增强
双眼晶体密度增高（早期晶状体硬化/退行性改变）
右眼视网膜激光术后

findings_14.explanation_zh: 豹纹状眼底是高度/中度近视引起的脉络膜色素变薄透见脉络膜大血管纹理的表现。视网膜细动脉变细、反光增强提示高血压性微血管硬化改变。晶体密度增高多为中年后晶状体老化的早期表现。结合患者既往有右眼视网膜激光治疗史，需定期监测视网膜周边状况。
findings_14.explanation_en: Tigroid fundus represents myopic choroidal thinning. Retinal arteriolar attenuation reflects chronic hypertensive microvascular change. Lens nuclear density increase represents early age-related crystalline lens sclerosis. Patient has a surgical history of right eye retinal photocoagulation.
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 养成良好用眼卫生习惯，避免剧烈头颅撞击或过度用眼。若出现眼前黑影飘动、异常闪光感或突重视力下降，需急诊眼科就诊。每年常规进行散瞳眼底检查及验光。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Annual dilated fundus examination and optical refraction. Seek immediate ophthalmology attention if floaters, photopsia (flashes of light), or visual field cuts develop.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 近视度数6.00D以上为高度近视，6.00D-3.00D为中度近视，3.00D以下为轻度近视。豹纹状眼底、漆裂样纹、斑块状视网膜脉络膜萎缩可见于高度近视和老年人的眼底，是一种视网膜脉络膜萎缩的表现。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 养成良好的用眼卫生习惯。如出现眼前黑影、闪光感或视力下降时，请及时眼科门诊就诊，如无不适，眼科门诊随诊，每6-12个月复查眼底、验光等。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Refractive errors >6.00 D constitute high myopia, 3.00-6.00 D moderate, and <3.00 D mild myopia. Tigroid fundus, lacquer cracks, and patchy chorioretinal atrophy occur in myopic eyes and aging retinas, reflecting thinning and attenuation of the retinal pigment epithelium and choroid.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Maintain visual hygiene. Seek urgent ophthalmic evaluation if sudden floaters, photopsia (flashes of light), or visual field cuts occur; otherwise routine follow-up with funduscopy and refraction every 6-12 months.

findings_14.title_zh: 肌酸激酶轻度增高 (Elevated Creatine Kinase 183 U/L)
findings_14.explanation_zh: 肌酸激酶（CK）在骨骼肌和心肌中高表达。本次CK为183 U/L，轻度超出中国医院参考值（<164 U/L）。但在多数欧美检验标准中，成年男性CK正常上限通常为200-250 U/L（183仍处于安全区间）。该轻度升高最常见于剧烈运动、肌肉疲劳受损，或服用他汀类降脂药（阿托伐他汀）引起的轻度肌酶波动。
findings_14.explanation_en: Serum CK is mildly elevated at 183 U/L against China hospital cutoff (<164 U/L), but sits comfortably below standard US adult male upper limits (200-250 U/L). Common benign etiologies include recent strenuous muscular exertion or mild statin-induced myopathy (patient is on Atorvastatin).
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 近期避免过度剧烈力量训练。如无肌痛、肌肉乏力或浓茶色尿，无需过度恐慌。建议在停用剧烈运动后1个月复查CK及CK-MB心肌同工酶，评估与降脂药物的关系。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Monitor for muscle soreness, tenderness, or weakness. Recheck CK in 4 weeks after resting from heavy exercise; verify liver enzymes and discuss statin regimen if symptoms appear.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 肌酸激酶增高分生理性和病理性，近期剧烈运动、肌肉拉伤、过度劳累等因素导致的生理性增高最为常见，病理性增高常见于以下情况：心肌损伤，如心肌梗死、急性心肌炎、心包炎等；进行性肌萎缩、肌炎、皮肌炎等；颅脑外伤后、癫痫发作、惊厥、脑膜炎及脑炎等；甲状腺功能异常、药物、酒精中毒等。偶尔一次轻度增高不一定有临床意义。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 健康管理门诊随诊，暂停剧烈运动后1个月内复查。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Elevated creatine kinase (CK) can be physiological or pathological. Physiological elevation commonly follows intense strenuous physical exertion, intramuscular strain, or extreme fatigue. Pathological causes encompass myocardial injury (infarction, myocarditis), polymyositis/dermatomyositis, CNS disorders (seizures, neurotrauma), hypothyroidism, or pharmacological/toxic etiologies. An isolated mild elevation usually lacks sinister clinical significance.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: Follow-up in Health Management Clinic; rest from heavy anaerobic physical exertion and repeat CK within 1 month.

key_metrics.value: 大小正常，两侧叶对称，实质内见高回声斑，未见明显占位，血流正常

findings_14.explanation_zh: 前列腺钙化灶是成年男性前列腺腺管内淀粉样小体钙盐沉着形成的良性生理改变，多由既往隐匿性前列腺炎性病变消退后遗留。前列腺大小完全正常，直肠指诊未及硬结，前列腺特异性抗原（Total PSA 0.5193 ng/mL）远低于4.0警戒线，完全排除恶性征象。
findings_14.explanation_en: Prostatic calcification is an incidental, benign finding resulting from quiescent prior focal inflammation. Prostate gland size is normal, and serum PSA is completely reassuring at 0.52 ng/mL (ref <4.0 ng/mL).
findings_14.recommendation_zh: 若无尿频、尿急、尿痛、夜尿增多或排尿等待等下尿路症状，无需任何药物或医疗干预。每年体检随访B超即可。
findings_14.recommendation_en: Reassurance; no treatment required in the absence of lower urinary tract symptoms (LUTS). Annual ultrasound follow-up.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_zh: 前列腺钙化灶是前列腺内的局部钙盐沉着。一般无症状，通常不需治疗。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_zh: 如无症状，不必治疗，每年复查B超，健康管理门诊随诊；如有尿频尿急尿痛或排尿不畅等不适，泌尿外科门诊就诊。
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_explanation_en: Prostatic calcification represents localized calcium salt deposition within prostatic acini, frequently secondary to past resolved asymptomatic prostatitis. It is typically benign, asymptomatic, and requires no interventional therapy.
findings_14.verbatim_hospital_recommendation_en: If asymptomatic, no treatment required; annual ultrasound checkup and Health Management follow-up. If dysuria, frequency, urgency, or urinary hesitancy develops, consult Urology clinic.

tcd.title_zh: 经颅多普勒脑血流分析 (TCD)
tcd.conclusion_zh: 双侧大脑中动脉血流速度对称、频谱形态正常；双侧椎动脉-基底动脉血流速度及频谱形态正常；双侧颈总动脉、颈内动脉颅外段、颈外动脉血流速度及频谱形态正常。TCD探及血管血流速度及频谱形态未见明显异常。
tcd.conclusion_en: Bilateral middle cerebral arteries (MCA) exhibit symmetric flow velocity and physiological waveforms. Vertebrobasilar arterial flows and extracranial carotid tree (CCA, ICA, ECA) demonstrate normal velocities and resistance indices. No significant hemodynamic stenosis or intracranial vascular abnormality detected.
tcd.parameter_units_note: 下表中，Peak、Mean、Dias的单位为cm/s，Depth单位为mm，其余参数无单位

arteriosclerosis.title_zh: 动脉硬化检测与血管弹性分析 (PWV / ABI)

right_bapwv.interpretation_zh: 轻度偏高，血管弹性轻度下降
right_bapwv.interpretation_en: Mildly elevated, indicating mild arterial stiffness

left_bapwv.interpretation_zh: 正常范围内，血管弹性良好

arteriosclerosis.conclusion_zh: 双侧ABI值属正常范围，双下肢主干动脉血流通畅无狭窄。右侧PWV值较年龄预测值轻度偏高（1477 vs 1228 cm/s），提示大动脉壁顺应性及弹性轻度下降；左侧PWV处于该年龄段正常范围。
arteriosclerosis.conclusion_en: Bilateral ABI values are within normal limits (1.12 and 1.10), ruling out peripheral artery disease (PAD) in the lower extremities. Right baPWV is mildly increased (1477 cm/s, +20% vs predicted 1228 cm/s), demonstrating mild early systemic arterial stiffening.

bone_density.conclusion_zh: T值 +0.15（正常标准 > -1.0），骨质正常。骨密度达到健康青年成人峰值的101.4%，为同龄参考值的110.6%。未见骨质减少或骨质疏松征象。
bone_density.conclusion_en: T-score is +0.15 (WHO normal criterion > -1.0 SD), consistent with normal bone mineral density. BMD is 101.4% of young adult peak and 110.6% of age-matched reference.
bone_density.disclaimer_zh: 该检查结果需结合临床，数据来源于骨密度正常人参照值数据库
bone_density.disclaimer_en: This test result should be correlated clinically; normative reference data derived from healthy bone mineral density population database.

ecg.conclusion_zh: 窦性心律，正常范围心电图。心率70次/分，P-R间期、QRS波群时程及QTc间期均在正常生理范围，无心肌缺血、传导阻滞或心律失常特征。
ecg.conclusion_en: Normal sinus rhythm at 70 bpm. Normal PR interval (148 ms), normal QTc (397 ms), normal QRS electrical axis (76°). Normal baseline 12-lead electrocardiogram.

ecg.diagnosis_zh: 窦性心律 正常范围心电图

ultrasound.title_zh: 高分辨率彩色超声多器官系统联合检查

organs.findings_zh: 甲状腺双侧叶大小、形态正常，包膜光整，实质回声不均匀，在甲状腺实质各见多个椭圆形低回声结节，右侧较大者约0.3cm，左侧较大者约0.5*0.2cm，边界及周边可辨，内部回声不均，CDFI示其内未见明显血流信号。彩色多普勒检查实质内血流未见异常。
organs.findings_en: Thyroid lobes are normal in size and contour with intact capsule. Parenchymal echotexture is mildly heterogeneous. Bilateral discrete oval hypoechoic nodules: largest on right measures 0.3 cm, largest on left measures 0.5 x 0.2 cm. Margins well-defined, no microcalcifications. Color Doppler shows no pathological internal vascularity.
organs.conclusion_zh: 甲状腺双侧叶实质回声不均伴多发结节 TI-RADS 3类
organs.conclusion_en: Bilateral thyroid heterogeneous echotexture with multiple small nodules (TI-RADS 3, benign appearance)

organs.findings_zh: 双侧颈动脉内径正常，内中膜增厚，较厚处约0.11cm（1.1mm），内膜不光整，动脉腔内未见明显异常回声，管腔未见狭窄，彩色多普勒血流充填良好。
organs.findings_en: Carotid lumen calibers are normal bilaterally. Intima-media thickening is present (max thickness 0.11 cm = 1.1 mm) with irregular intimal surface. No luminal stenosis or discrete atherosclerotic plaques. Color Doppler indicates laminar flow without filling defects.
organs.conclusion_zh: 双侧颈动脉内中膜增厚

organs.findings_zh: 肝脏大小正常，包膜光整，肝实质光点细密，回声增高，分布均匀，肝实质内未见明显占位性病变，肝实质后方回声衰减，肝内血管走行显示欠清，门静脉内径正常范围，内部透声好，CDFI显示血流充盈佳。
organs.findings_en: Normal liver dimensions with smooth contours. Parenchymal echoes are finely increased and diffusely brightened with posterior acoustic attenuation; intrahepatic vascular architecture is mildly attenuated. Portal vein diameter and flow velocities are normal.

organs.findings_zh: 胆囊切除术后改变。肝内胆管未见明显扩张，总胆管上段内径正常，总胆管内未见异常回声或结石嵌顿。
organs.findings_en: Post-cholecystectomy status. Intrahepatic and extrahepatic biliary ducts are non-dilated. Common bile duct upper caliber is normal without intraductal filling defects or residual calculi.
organs.conclusion_zh: 胆囊切除术后，肝内外胆管不扩张
organs.conclusion_en: Status post cholecystectomy; no biliary tree dilatation

organs.findings_zh: 胰腺大小形态正常，实质回声均匀，CDFI未见异常。脾脏大小正常，形态规则，包膜光整，脾实质回声均匀，CDFI未见异常。
organs.findings_en: Pancreas and spleen are normal in size, shape, and parenchymal echotexture. No focal masses or vascular anomalies.
organs.conclusion_zh: 胰腺、脾脏未见明显异常

organs.findings_zh: 左侧肾脏大小正常，形态规则，包膜光整，实质回声均匀，皮髓质分界清晰，实质内未见占位，集合系统无积水分离。在集合系统内见一个强光团，大小约0.5cm，后方伴声影，CDFI示血流充盈良好。
organs.findings_en: Left kidney normal in size and cortical thickness with sharp corticomedullary differentiation. No hydronephrosis. Solitary 0.5 cm hyperechoic calculus with acoustic shadowing located within the lower collecting system. Renal vascular perfusion intact.

organs.findings_zh: 右侧肾脏大小正常，形态规则，包膜光整，实质回声均匀，皮髓质分界清晰，集合系统未见分离，CDFI示肾血流充盈良好。双侧输尿管未见扩张。膀胱充盈后扫查，壁光整，无异常回声。
organs.findings_en: Right kidney unremarkable with normal parenchyma and no pelvicalyceal dilatation. Bilateral ureters not dilated. Urinary bladder wall is smooth with clear anechoic lumen.
organs.conclusion_zh: 右肾、双侧输尿管、膀胱未见明显异常
organs.conclusion_en: Normal right kidney, bilateral ureters, and urinary bladder

organs.findings_zh: 前列腺大小正常，两侧叶对称，包膜光整，实质内回声不均匀，并可见高回声斑，未见占位性病变，彩色多普勒未见异常血流信号。
organs.findings_en: Prostate gland is normal in size and symmetric. Internal echotexture shows focal hyperechoic calcification plaques without suspicious nodular masses. Normal vascularity.

ultrasound.exam_items_en: Bilateral Thyroid Ultrasound, Liver/Gallbladder/Pancreas/Spleen Ultrasound, Kidneys/Ureters/Bladder/Prostate Ultrasound, Bilateral Carotid Ultrasound
ultrasound.disclaimer_zh: 本报告仅供临床医师参考
ultrasound.disclaimer_en: This report is for clinical physician reference only.

chest_ct.findings_zh: 肺窗显示两肺支气管血管束清晰，走向分布无异常，左肺下叶少许小钙化结节，直径约3-4mm（注：医院原报告打印排版作'敬业3-4mm'），余肺实质未见明显渗出或实质性占位性病变。附见：胆囊术后改变。
chest_ct.findings_en: Bronchovascular bundles in bilateral lung fields are clear with anatomical distribution. Left lower lung lobe exhibits small calcified nodules measuring 3-4 mm in diameter. No active consolidation, ground-glass opacity, or space-occupying mass. Incidental note: post-cholecystectomy surgical changes.
chest_ct.conclusion_zh: 左肺下叶少许小钙化灶，请随诊。
chest_ct.conclusion_en: Small calcified nodules in left lower lobe, benign sequelae; routine follow-up recommended.

cervical_cr.findings_zh: 颈椎生理性曲度变直。颈椎前、后缘骨质增生。椎体附件未见明显异常。椎间隙未见明显狭窄。
cervical_cr.findings_en: Straightening of normal cervical lordosis. Hypertrophic osteophyte formation along anterior and posterior vertebral margins. Posterior elements intact. Intervertebral disc space heights are reasonably maintained.
